g: (LGBTQ, slang) A trans woman, a male-to-female transsexual or transgender person.
(LGBTQ) Not binary cisgender; belonging to a gender minority.
(LGBTQ, potentially offensive) A person who is not binary cisgender.

(paraphilia) A transformation involving the development of physical characteristics usually associated with a different gender (e.g. a man growing breasts). May or may not involve an actual change in gender identity.
